Termio: Surface-owned session engine (src/termio/Termio.zig)
|
|-- backend: Backend.exec -> owned Exec (src/termio/Exec.zig)
|   |-- subprocess: Subprocess
|   |   |-- PTY + configured shell/command
|   |   `-- start() -> Pty.open + launch
|   |-- threadEnter/threadExit -> manage reader lifetime
|   |   |-- POSIX: io-gather -> bounded rotating buffers -> io-reader
|   |   `-- Windows: blocking read + processing in one loop
|   `-- queueWrite() -> PTY -> child input
|-- terminal_stream: owned terminal.Stream(StreamHandler)
|   `-- nextSlice(bytes) -> handler -> this Termio's Terminal
|-- terminal: owned terminal.Terminal (sole session emulation state)
|   `-- screens: ScreenSet -> owned Screens -> PageLists -> pages
|-- mailbox: owned input / protocol replies / control queue
|   `-- Surface.io_thread drains -> queueWrite -> Backend.queueWrite
|-- config: owned DerivedConfig; size: current renderer.Size
|-- borrowed links: Surface.renderer_state + renderer/surface mailboxes
|   `-- renderer_state.terminal -> &terminal (not a second terminal)
|-- processOutput(bytes): called by Exec reader
|   |-- Lock Surface.renderer_state.mutex
|   |-- handler.queueRender() while locked -> renderer wakeup
|   |-- terminal_stream.nextSlice -> mutate terminal
|   |-- Notify mailbox if handler queued protocol replies
|   `-- Unlock; reader yieldToDemand -> pending renderer snapshot
|-- resize(size): called after Surface.io_thread coalesces requests
|   |-- size.grid(): pixels + cell metrics + padding
|   |-- Under same mutex: Backend.resize then Terminal.resize
|   |   `-- Child redraw cannot be parsed at obsolete dimensions
|   `-- -> renderer mailbox .resize + wakeup
`-- deinit(): backend / terminal / config / mailbox / stream resources
